init.title: OCPP Charge Proxy Options

data.soc_entity: SoC sensor for reporting to your OCPP provider (optional)
data.auto_plug: Plug in automatically when the SoC drops low
data.auto_plug_entity: SoC sensor to watch for auto plug-in (optional)

init.description: Optional: a power sensor to report real power instead of the simulation, and a SoC sensor whose value is reported to your OCPP provider as the charging car's state of charge. Clear a field to stop using it.

data_description.soc_entity: Only for reporting the car's state of charge to your OCPP provider. When it reads 100% the charger also reports the car as full (SuspendedEV), and power tapers above 90%. Auto plug-in can watch a different sensor below.
data_description.plug_entity: A binary sensor (e.g. your car's 'charging cable connected'). When it turns on, Plugged In is switched on. It never switches Plugged In off: unplug with the switch (or an automation) as usual. Works alongside auto plug-in.
data_description.auto_plug: Switches Plugged In on once when the watched SoC drops below the level below; it won't plug back in if you unplug by hand while the SoC is still low.
data_description.auto_plug_entity: Leave empty to watch the reporting SoC sensor above. Set a different one to watch it only for auto plug-in: it is never reported to your provider (useful for a car that may be away from home).
data_description.auto_plug_soc: SoC (%) below which Plugged In is switched on.
